ann.Translation: Be Gracious to me, Be Gracious to me my friends
For the hand of God has struck me
Why do you pursue me like God
not satisfied with my flesh
Then who will write down my words
who will enscribe them in a book
with an iron pen
and be engraved in lead on a rock
I, I know
and he will stand upon the dust of the earth
And after my sin has been destroyed
and I am without flesh, I will see God
That I will see for myself
and my eyes will see and not a stranger (outsider)
my kidneys fail in my lap (my heart faints within me?)
if you say, How we will persue him!
And the root of the matter is found in him
Be afraid of the sword
for wrath (brings) punishment of the sword
so that, you may know (there) is a judgement

and he will stand upon the dust of the earth
